    name: $name
    databaseName: $databaseName
    databaseUser: $databaseUser
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId

    version: $version

variables.sql: CREATE TABLE qa_a720_placement AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'snow 雪'::text, 12.3400::numeric(12,4), '{"state":"one","items":[1,null,"雪"]}'::jsonb), (2, NULL::text, NULL::numeric(12,4), NULL::jsonb), (3, ''::text, -0.1250::numeric(12,4), '[]'::jsonb)) AS seed(id,label,amount,doc);
SELECT current_setting('server_version_num') AS version_num, id, label, amount::text AS amount, doc::text AS doc FROM qa_a720_placement ORDER BY id;
